The final volume of the system after the NVT relaxation is 6226.4081 Å³. To calculate the density, we need the mass of the system. Magnesium has an atomic mass of approximately 24.305 g/mol.

Given:
- Number of atoms = 250
- Volume = 6226.4081 Å³ = 6.2264081 x 10⁻²¹ cm³
- Atomic mass of Mg = 24.305 g/mol
- Avogadro's number = 6.022 x 10²³ atoms/mol

First, calculate the total mass of the system:
\[ \text{Total mass} = \frac{250 \text{ atoms}}{6.022 \times 10^{23} \text{ atoms/mol}} \times 24.305 \text{ g/mol} \]

\[ \text{Total mass} = 1.008 \times 10^{-21} \text{ g} \]

Now, calculate the density:
\[ \text{Density} = \frac{\text{Total mass}}{\text{Volume}} = \frac{1.008 \times 10^{-21} \text{ g}}{6.2264081 \times 10^{-21} \text{ cm}^3} \]

\[ \text{Density} = 0.162 \text{ g/cm}^3 \]

Final Answer: 0.162
